Under the supervision of the Management Services Officer, the Special Events Coordinator plans, coordinates, and executes Bunche Center events and meetings, including event logistics, communications, registration, vendor coordination, budgets, travel, catering, audiovisual support, and onsite event production. The position coordinates with campus units, community partners, government offices, speakers, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure successful event delivery. The position also provides purchasing, travel, and administrative support associated with Center events and operations.
Flexibility in accepting new or special assignments and/or projects on short notice to enable the Center to cover essential functions and/or meet urgent deadlines
On-site leadership and problem-solving under pressure

Skill in organizing material and information in a systematic way to optimize efficiency and minimize duplication of effort. Skill in analyzing information and situations to define the problem and/or objective, identify issues, and formulate logical conclusions
Strong project management skills, including timelines, vendor coordination, and budget oversight

Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with co-workers, administrators, faculty, vendors, and external sources. Excellent verbal communication skills to interact effectively and diplomatically with others

Ability to complete work assignments accurately and with attention to detail. Demonstrated skill in organizing work, defining tasks, setting priorities, working independently and following through on all assignments with minimal direction and supervision
Ability to manage simultaneous events and shifting priorities with professionalism and discretion
Familiarity with security coordination and high-level guest logistics where appropriate.
Ability to handle confidential material with discretion
